profile.headline: Android Engineer | Streaming, Live Video & Connected TV | Kotlin · Compose · ExoPlayer · Android TV
profile.summary:
I've been building Android since Android 2.0 in 2009 — mostly consumer streaming and living-room apps, where the hard part is rarely the feature itself but everything around it: multiple brands, multiple form factors, and hardware you can't hotfix.
At Peacock I work on the shared Android codebase behind NBC, NBC Sports, Bravo, Telemundo, and Universo — one repository, product flavors per brand, shipping to phone, tablet, Android TV, and Fire TV. Most recently that included Telemundo's Spanish-language World Cup coverage.
Before that I spent seven years at Xperi leading the Play-Fi TV app, which shipped on Philips TVs from the 2020 through 2026 model years across both the EU and China lines, alongside SDKs and integration tools for partner devices.
I'm drawn to the layer other engineers build on — architecture, shared components, and the tooling that keeps one codebase shippable across a lot of targets.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Android
positions.description:
Build data-driven browse and discovery UI in a shared Android repository serving NBC, NBC Sports, Bravo, Telemundo, and Universo as product flavors across phone, tablet, Android TV, and Fire TV.
Deliver playback and discovery features backed by a GraphQL BFF, partnering with design and backend teams on query and response contracts.
Shipped Telemundo's Spanish-language World Cup coverage against a fixed launch date.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Kotlin · GraphQL · Jetpack Compose · Android TV

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - Android
positions.description:
Led the Play-Fi TV app end to end — shipped on Philips TVs across the 2020–2026 model years, in both the EU and China product lines.
Designed the app's Android architecture (MVVM, Coroutines/Flow, modular components), using Gradle product flavors to carry seven annual hardware generations and two regional lines from a single repository.
Built reusable SDKs, components, and integration tools for third-party partner devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Mobile App
positions.description:
Migrated the Android streaming player from ExoPlayer 1 to ExoPlayer 2.
Integrated the Facebook Audience Network SDK for in-stream video ads.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Java · Streaming Media
